[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Tekton and Kubernetes-Native CI/CD Pipelines"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Tekton is a powerful, flexible, Kubernetes-native open-source framework for creating continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems. By abstracting underlying infrastructure, Tekton enables developers to build, test, and deploy across multiple cloud providers and on-premises environments with ease."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Architecture"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A running Kubernetes cluster (v1.20 or higher)."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"kubectl CLI tool installed and configured."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Basic understanding of Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Installing Tekton Pipelines"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To install Tekton Pipelines on your Kubernetes cluster, apply the official release manifest using kubectl."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"kubectl apply --filename https://storage.googleapis.com/tekton-releases/pipeline/latest/release.yaml"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Verify that the Tekton controller pods are running successfully in the tekton-pipelines namespace."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"kubectl get pods --namespace tekton-pipelines"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Creating Your First Tekton Task"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"A Task is a collection of steps that execute sequentially. Below is an example of a simple Task that prints a hello message."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1beta1
kind: Task
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  steps:
    - name: echo
      image: ubuntu
      script: |
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        echo "Hello from Tekton!""},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Executing via TaskRun"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"To instantiate and run the Task, you create a TaskRun object. This triggers the execution on your cluster."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1beta1
kind: TaskRun
metadata:
  name: hello-run
spec:
  taskRef:
    name: hello"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"Apply the TaskRun manifest and view the logs to see the output of your pipeline step."},{"order":19,"type":"code","text":"kubectl apply -f taskrun.yaml
kubectl logs --follow taskrun/hello-run"},{"order":20,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":21,"type":"paragraph","text":"By leveraging Kubernetes CRDs, Tekton provides ephemeral, scalable, and cloud-agnostic CI/CD workflows. You can now extend these concepts to build complex multi-step pipelines containing build, test, and deployment phases."}]
